title: Amazon loses legal battle over hazardous product recalls
excerpt: Amazon must handle recalls for over 400,000 hazardous items after losing a court battle with the Consumer Product Safety Commission.
body_html:
Amazon has lost a legal challenge against the US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) and must now manage the recall of over 400,000 hazardous products.

The ruling was issued by the US District Court for the District of Maryland. The court sided with the CPSC, which maintained that Amazon acts as a distributor of goods rather than merely a logistics provider.

As a result of the decision, the e-commerce company remains responsible for facilitating the safety notices and handling the recalled merchandise.
